description.zh: 庇佑一名最前排的友军，使其获得400%攻击力的护盾，持续6秒，并使该目标在接下来6秒内受到伤害降低20%，会优先选择拥有【金苹果】的友军释放
description.en: Protects an ally in the front row, granting them a Shield equal to 400% of ATK for 6s, and reduces their DMG taken by 20% for the next 6s. Prioritizes the ally with [Golden Apple].

level2.zh: 护盾和受到伤害降低持续时间提升至8秒
level2.en: Shield and DMG reduction duration extends to 8s.

level3.zh: 持续期间该目标受到伤害降低40%
level3.en: The target takes 40% reduced DMG for the duration.

level4.en: Grants a Shield equal to 500% of ATK.

description.zh: 祝福最虚弱的1名友军，恢复250%攻击力+目标15%已损失生命的生命值，该效果对拥有【金苹果】的友军额外释放一次
description.en: Blesses the 1 weakest ally, restoring HP equal to 250% of ATK + 15% of the target's lost HP. This effect is cast one extra time on allies with [Golden Apple].

level2.zh: 恢复生命值提升至270%攻击力

level3.zh: 恢复目标25%已损失生命值
level3.en: Restores 25% of the target's lost HP.

level4.zh: 恢复生命值提升至300%攻击力

description.zh: 被动的，伊登战斗中赋予距离自身最近的友方前排友军【金苹果】（金苹果：获得伊登10%的攻击力，生命值，护甲和魔抗）
description.en: Passive: In battle, Idunn grants [Golden Apple] to the nearest front-row ally. ([Golden Apple]: Grants 10% of Idunn's ATK, HP, Armor, and M-RES.)

level2.zh: 金苹果目标获得伊登15%的攻击力，生命值，护甲和魔抗
level2.en: [Golden Apple] grants the target 15% of Idunn's ATK, HP, Armor, and M-RES.

level3.zh: 【金苹果】目标存活时，伊登受到伤害降低50%
level3.en: While the [Golden Apple] target is alive, Idunn takes 50% reduced DMG.

level4.zh: 金苹果目标获得伊登20%的攻击力，生命值，护甲和魔抗
level4.en: [Golden Apple] grants the target 20% of Idunn's ATK, HP, Armor, and M-RES.

description.zh: 被动的，伊登即将阵亡时，召唤金苹果罩住自身，获得75%最大生命值的护盾，持续5秒，持续期间，护盾以每秒20%最大生命值的效率转化为自身生命值，该效果一场战斗只能触发一次
description.en: Passive: When Idunn is about to fall, she summons a Golden Apple to cover herself, gaining a Shield equal to 75% of max HP for 5s. During this time, the Shield converts into her HP at a rate of 20% of her max HP per second. This effect can only be triggered once per battle.

level2.zh: 获得100%最大生命值的护盾
level2.en: Gains a Shield equal to 100% of max HP.

level3.zh: 护盾持续期间伊登受到伤害降低70%
level3.en: Idunn takes 70% reduced DMG while shielded.

level4.zh: 获得125%最大生命值的护盾
level4.en: Gains a Shield equal to 125% of max HP.

description.en: If the target of the Ultimate is an ally with [Golden Apple], they gain an additional 40% of Idunn's ATK for 10s.
description.zh: 终结技的目标若是拥有【金苹果】的友军，10秒内额外获得伊登的40%攻击力

level2.zh: 终结技的目标若是拥有【金苹果】的友军，10秒内额外获得30%会心率
level2.en: If the target of the Ultimate is an ally with [Golden Apple], they gain an additional 30% CRIT Rate for 10s.

level3.zh: 终结技的目标若是拥有【金苹果】的友军，使目标10秒内获得霸体
level3.en: If the target of the Ultimate is an ally with [Golden Apple], they gain Super Armor for 10s.

level4.zh: 终结技的目标若是拥有【金苹果】的友军，10秒内额外获得30%会心伤害
level4.en: If the target of the Ultimate is an ally with [Golden Apple], they gain an additional 30% CRIT DMG for 10s.
